name: Aikawa Miku
source:
Cheerful and gentle natured, nice girl.
Good grades at school, relatively good at sports as well, but a little "natural airhead". Chest surprisingly big.
Liked by both boys and girls of the classrom but is not really interessed in the opposite sex.
Is rather insensitive.
